boundary: This is an active-configuration readback, not a traffic-volume measurement or a claim that a distributed enforcement probe was executed.
The Vercel WAF rules complement, rather than replace, the application-layer same-origin checks, exact feature gates, schema limits, and per-instance request budgets.
No IP address, API key, password, endpoint credential, request body, provider response, or learner event is recorded here.
